title: Nine Photographs of One House
subtitle: 摄影影像 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 摄影影像（文学艺术与体育·摄影与记录）
meta: 主题语境：摄影影像（文学艺术与体育·摄影与记录）　|　核心词汇：angle　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 angle 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 my uncle took nine photographs of the same house and said the ① angle was the only thing that had changed, and my grandmother said that proved the house was not worth photographing. He said ② at an angle everything in a life looks deliberate, and she said that is the trouble with angles; an angle, he said, is a decision about where to stand.

The house stood ③ at a right angle to the road, which my father said was the only honest thing about it, and the council pulled it down in 1981. My teacher drew ④ an angle on the board in 1966 and said it was nine degrees, and I have never forgotten the word degrees, or the fact that she was wrong; every angle, my uncle said, is a promise you cannot keep.

In 1979 he photographed the same wall ⑤ from a different angle once a year for nine years, and the nine pictures are all of a wall. There was ⑥ an angle of the yard nobody had ever photographed, and he said the unphotographed angle is the only thing a place has left, and my grandmother said a yard has better things than that.

The ⑦ angle of view he wrote about in 1984, meaning how much of a thing you can get into one picture, was nine feet wide at most. My mother said there was ⑧ another angle, meaning the neighbours, and he said that was not an angle but a fact, and she said all angles are facts somebody has chosen; an angle, she said, is a fact with a place to stand.

The ⑨ angle I would choose, if I had a camera, is the one from the yard in 1979, which nobody wanted and which he took nine times. An ⑩ angle, he told me in 1990, is the only thing in a photograph that the photographer decided and the viewer never notices; every angle, he said, is chosen twice, and the photographer is the only person who ever sees it.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 角（几何）；角度数
B. n. （观察、思考的）角度；立场
D. n. 着眼点；着眼之处
E. 固定搭配：from a different angle 从不同的角度
F. 固定搭配：at an angle 倾斜着；斜着
G. 固定搭配：a right / sharp angle 直角／锐角
H. 固定搭配：angle of view 视角

items.q: the angle was the only thing that had changed
at an angle everything in a life
at a right angle to the road
drew an angle on the board
from a different angle once a year
an angle of the yard nobody
The angle of view he wrote about
there was another angle, meaning the neighbours
An angle, he told me in 1990

answers.why: angle 意为“（观察的）角度”，1972 年他给同一座房子拍了九张照片，说唯一变的是角度。
at an angle 意为“斜着、倾斜着”，他说斜着看，一生中一切都显得是刻意的。
a right angle 意为“直角”，那座房子与道路成直角，父亲说那是它唯一诚实的地方。
angle 意为“（几何的）角”，1966 年老师在黑板上画了一个角，说它是九度。
from a different angle 意为“从不同的角度”，1979 年起他每年从不同的角度拍同一堵墙，拍了九年。
angle 意为“角落、斜角”，院子里有一个从没人拍过的角落，他说那是一个地方仅剩的东西。
angle of view 意为“视角”，1984 年他写到的视角，指的是一张照片能装下多少东西。
angle 意为“着眼点”，母亲说还有一个着眼点——邻居。
angle 意为“角落、斜角”，若我有一台相机，我要选的是 1979 年院子那个没人要的角落。
angle 意为“（拍摄的）角度、立场”，他说角度是照片里唯一由拍摄者决定、观看者从不注意的东西。
